summary.en: Chinese bomber flights and a surveillance plane continue near the Philippine coast and in the West Philippine Sea, while the Armed Forces observed 48 Chinese Coast Guard and PLA Navy vessels across four disputed features, more than double the prior count. The Philippine Coast Guard commissioned three locally built survey ships and three new patrol vessels, and received five new Coast Guard ships from Japan, expanding its capabilities. French Navy ships conducted joint drills with the Philippine Coast Guard in the Sulu Sea, and a Chinese coast guard vessel fired a water cannon at a Philippine vessel. The conflict recorded 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
